translations.web: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.
translations.bsb: My Father who has given them to Me is greater than all. No one can snatch them out of My Father’s hand.
translations.kjv: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father's hand.
translations.asv: My Father, who hath given them unto me, is greater than all; and no one is able to snatch them out of the Father's hand.
